(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein the light emitting diodes are configured to emit light in a range of RGB colors.__

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and configured to allow for ventilation. __

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, __and configured to direct light outwardly from the columnar body. __

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __70 W/mK.__

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __70 W/mK, configured to provide enhanced thermal management__, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __70 W/mK__, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein said method further comprises implementing a cooling solution within the lamp structure.__ 

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __of said columnar body, wherein the diodes are configured to provide diffuse illumination. __
